summary: Tested new CRM enhancements: (1) Closing Resume WhatsApp notification to Main/Management group + Settings toggle & field, (2) full Ticket History page at /crm/ticket/{id}/history with auth-redirect-back and mobile responsiveness. All backend pytest cases (6/6) and all frontend flows PASSED. Settings were reset to enabled=false, send_closing_resume=false, main_group='' after tests to avoid real sends.
critical_code_review_comments: notify_closing_resume gracefully handles missing main_group by delegating to send_message which logs status='skipped' with target empty — good. Close still succeeds. Verified.

notify_closing_resume is called AFTER notify_ticket_event('resolved') in crm_helpdesk.py line 878 as documented; ticket status persists as SELESAI even when send fails (dummy token) — no rollback. Verified.
Public settings response correctly exposes main_group + send_closing_resume without leaking token; token stored encrypted via Fernet — good.
TicketHistory.jsx builds the timeline entirely from existing ticket fields (progress, reassign_history, audit fields). No new collection introduced — matches requirement.
seed_data_creation: Created 4 TEST_CustClose_* tickets via API during tests (each was processed + resolved). Existing demo ticket TCK-20260810-0002 (fd93dfdd-1ad3-4d98-9776-c23495340b86) used for history-page UI verification.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend pytest at /app/backend/tests/test_closing_resume.py covers: settings persist main_group + send_closing_resume, closing_resume log fires on close with correct target/message/history_url, does NOT fire when toggle OFF, close endpoint returns 200 SELESAI even when main_group empty, resolve validation regression. Frontend: /settings/notifications/gateway exposes wa-maingroup-input + wa-closing-resume-switch + notif-save-btn; /crm/ticket/{id}/history exposes ticket-history-page, history-ticket-number, history-timeline, history-back-btn, history-doc-gallery; auth-redirect-back via ProtectedRoute state.from -> Login.jsx works. Mobile @390px shows no horizontal overflow (scrollWidth == clientWidth). Notification settings have been reset to enabled=false, send_closing_resume=false, main_group='' to prevent unintended sends.
